user.title: Mainzer Netze portal login
user.description: Log in with your credentials for the metering portal at msb.mainzer-netze.de.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter password
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Please enter the current password.

error.captcha_required: The portal requires a captcha, usually after failed login attempts. Log in once at msb.mainzer-netze.de in your web browser, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the portal. Please try again later.
error.no_meters: Login worked, but no meters are assigned to this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from the portal. Check the logs for details.
